Destroy every opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. After this effect resolves, if the opponent controls any 15000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate, during this turn, this Spirit can't be blocked, and for each of those Spirit/Ultimate, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.

You can [Advent] onto this Spirit-condition Brave. When you [Advent] onto this Brave, you can brave this pre-Advent card to that Spirit.
